text: GrowERP Insurance for Tasco: compulsory motor insurance renewal that customers are glad to act on. The right reminder, at the right moment, on the right channel, and a person whenever they want one.
Every insurer sells the same TNDS cover at the same regulated price. So renewal is won on timing, clarity and an easy next step, never on discounts.

Staff start in the renewal cockpit. Every customer due in the next sixty days gets an explainable lead score from renewal history, reactions to earlier reminders, consent and profile completeness, plus the next best channel and the time this customer usually reads messages.

For this customer the score says Zalo, in the evening. AI drafts the reminder in Vietnamese from the policy facts only: calm, no discounts, one clear next step and how to stop. Staff can edit it before it goes.
The customer receives it on Zalo. In the pilot this is Tasco's Zalo Official Account or the VETC app; here we show the message as it would appear.

One tap opens a private renewal page. No app and no login: the customer confirms the car with the last three characters of the plate, then renews, asks for a call, or tells us the car was sold. Instead of price tricks it shows real service: the digital certificate, help with claims, roadside assistance.

Customers who prefer to talk get a respectful AI call in Vietnamese. It asks permission first, confirms the vehicle, answers questions from the policy only, and hands over to a person whenever the customer asks.
The hand-over lands in the telesales queue with an AI summary and the transcript, so the colleague starts where the AI stopped, and records the outcome with the same call codes the CRM uses.
Every step is measured: reminded, opened, visited, confirmed and renewed, by channel and by score band. That is how a four week pilot proves the effect on renewal against today's baseline.
Explainable scores, consent and opt-out at every step, and people make the decisions. GrowERP is free and open source; Tasco pays only for the production environment, enhancements and support.
